steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ summary containing one vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required bidding-time rejection configuration.
Enable buyer editing of bidding fields as required.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage's submission-time dialog from Settings.
Accept the values already present in the dialog without changing them.
Verify that Procol saved the extension and displayed the expected confirmation.
